newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonian stocks close lower amid solid trade.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonian stocks close lower amid solid trade.

text.p: Trade was solid on Monday on the Tallinn stock exchange as most bank stocks closed lower in a market whose direction is still unclear, dealers said.
The Talse index fell by 2.03 percent to close on 272.09 with 53.4 million kroons of shares traded on the main list.
"It was solid day's trade with some larger blocks pushing the volumes up," one trader said.
"It seem that some short-term investors were cashing in their stock to fill cash needs for the second quarter and some others were taking profits from the recent rise," he added.
"The market may move upwards slightly tomorrow but then selling pressure could easily take it all lower so no clear trend has been established yet," another dealer said.
Hansapank turned over 14.9 million kroons of shares to be 2.50 lower on 141.50 kroons.
Forekspank saw trade of 14 million kroons of shares to close on 191.00, a drop of four kroons.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was seven million kroons of shares with diversified industrialist Norma the most active stock.
Norma ended trade on 77.30 kroons, a slight loss of 0.25 kroons, and turned over 2.9 million kroons.
